outcome: Only valid categorical scoring signals enter the single-label evaluator; observations remain separate.

artifacts.purpose: Single-label output conversion and artifact-wide signal checks

interfaces: CategoricalDistribution retains submitted binary64 values separately from normalized working values in vocabulary order.
SingleLabelOutput contains Outcome<LabelIndex> plus optional scoring probability/confidence.
SignalAvailability is calculated over the entire submitted artifact before selection, independently of observations.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly every vocabulary key is required; finite [0,1], positive sum, abs(sum-1)<=1e-9; normalize only accepted near-unit vectors.
General classifiers retain non-argmax decisions and signals on abstentions; scored_choice requires question ID, class, confidence, distribution, and a tied maximum.
Each scoring family is independently all-or-none across all sources; empty submitted artifacts have neither family.

verification.expected: Missing/extra keys, wrong kinds, booleans/strings, sum errors fail without clipping or repair.
Any exact maximum is legal; contradictory selections rejected.
No partial scoring family; abstentions retain valid signals.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
